purpose: Teach: やっこ/一足/脅かす/隔て/嫌気/愉し/溜め/好転

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、夏メニューに冷ややっこも加えようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's add hiyayakko to the summer menu, okay?
lines.style: Warm, collaborative suggestion. Soft opening. Gentle rise on the idea, then settling into shared decision-making. No demand—partnership. Eye contact level, inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、開店の一足先に準備を済ませようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's finish the prep before we open—get ahead of the rush, yeah?
lines.style: Practical and focused. Steady, calm rhythm. A working partner thinking through logistics. Light energy, no urgency, just clear-headed teamwork.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様を脅かすような演出は避けようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's make sure we don't do anything that might startle the customers.
lines.style: Gentle caution. Thoughtful pace. Not lecturing—just a quiet note about care. Soft finish, like she's thinking it through aloud with Aoi.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の席を隔てて静かに過ごせる空間を作ろう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's create a space where customers can sit apart and feel peaceful, okay?
lines.style: Warm intentionality. Measured, deliberate pacing. She's painting a picture of what they're building together. Soft confidence in the vision.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、忙しさに嫌気が差さないよう気を付けようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's keep an eye out so the busyness doesn't wear us down.
lines.style: Protective care, gently voiced. A beat of pause before 'so the busyness'—she's checking in on both of them. Intimate, not maternal.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の愉しい時間を支えようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's support our customers' good moments, yeah?
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Slow, purposeful delivery. This is the real work—not the menu, but this. A gentle reminder of why they're doing it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、ポイントを溜める制度を作ろうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's set up a points system—give people a reason to come back.
lines.style: Practical problem-solving with warmth. Light lift on 'points'—this is an idea she's pleased with. Steady, collaborative tone. Not business-speak, just care.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、売上が好転してきたね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the sales are starting to turn around, aren't they?
lines.style: Quiet relief and pleasure. Warm recognition of shared effort paying off. Slight lift at the end—not triumphant, but genuinely pleased. Relaxed exhale underneath.
